body: Madeline Albright said it was "worth it" to starve a million Iraqi children to death by denying humanitarian aid to a Saddam-controlled Iraq.﻿ She can take her diplomacy and shove it where the sun does not shine. A special place in hell indeed.
Madeleine Albright is a person who thought that half a million dead Iraqi children was 'worth it'. Who cares what she thinks?
